notes: Generate Map only: after a layout is built, about share of each base wall's pieces become one of its variants, written into the map as real tiles (so hand-painted walls stay plain). Designer request (Oct 2026): the main wall is the base wall with the set's other wall tiles randomly thrown in, for every tile set.

panelVariants replace a whole two-tile plain panel (never a window panel); tileVariants replace a single wall tile that doesn't pair into a panel. A set whose base wall has no entry here keeps plain walls (only Starship & Station and Klingon Ship & Station have more than one wall tile so far).
share 0.4: the share the old draw-time bulkhead fittings used (tileEffects.json wallVariants, before Oct 2026). Implementation default awaiting designer review.

klingonBulkhead share 0.25: lower than the Starship walls because both Klingon variants are lit and animated. Implementation default awaiting designer review. The closed Klingon door is left out so a generated map never shows a door that doesn't open.
